issues.description: Invalid ingests persist valid rows before the malformed-row threshold check returns failure.
GPU TRES parsing double-counts AllocTRES values that contain both typed and aggregate GPU entries.
Failure reports miss Slurm OUT_OF_MEMORY jobs because only OOM is included in FAILURE_STATES.
Unconditional upserts allow older snapshots to regress newer job states and timestamps.
Rows with extra pipe-delimited columns are not rejected, so malformed input can be silently accepted.
Custom argparse error handling raises SystemExit with a string, producing exit code 1 instead of standard CLI usage error code 2.
Report queries filter on COALESCE(end, start, submit), making the existing timestamp index largely ineffective on large databases.
Database initialization has no schema versioning or migration path for existing user databases.
Negative GPU counts in AllocTRES are accepted and can produce negative GPU-hour totals.
Parsing materializes the whole input file before ingest, which does not scale well for large sacct exports.
